--- --- ---

[CP] Add sliding-window varlen selective gather

## Summary (human-written)
Selective gather -- only gathering the required blocks instead of doing allgather.

Integrate selective gather CP for sliding window VarlenAttn. This PR depends on
https://github.com/meta-pytorch/attention-gym/pull/651.

This version assumes CP is within the same nvlink domain. A cross-nvlink domain version require the next attention-gym PR.

## Why
K/V all-gather copies tokens that sliding-window attention cannot use. Keep local K/V and gather only remote window blocks through attention-gym's copy-engine exchange.

Example: CP8, 128K tokens per rank, window 4096, block size 256:

```
All-gather K/V:         1024K tokens
Compact K/V:       at most 136K tokens
Saved remote K/V:  at most   8K tokens with full remat
```

These are buffer-size bounds. They exclude shared transport buffers and other activations. With full remat, all-gather also releases gathered K/V but fetches it again during backward. Selective gather retains halos to avoid that fetch. Model peak memory must be measured for each policy.

## What changed
- Use attention-gym's public builder for fixed contiguous or head-tail routing. Reuse exchanges across matching layers. Packed document offsets can change during CUDA Graph replay.
- Save remote K/V under full remat. During backward, rebuild compact K/V from local K/V and saved halos without fetching remote K/V again.
- Check compact K/V SPMD types and load-balancer compatibility. Support no balancer and head-tail; reject PTRR. Attention-gym validates actual token-range alignment.
- Keep the generic Muse Glimmer integration on all-gather. The H100 recipe selects selective sliding attention through the same setup, with full remat and real process groups.
- Mechanical: share varlen chunk helpers with all-gather.

## User-facing changes
| Attention | Backend |
| --- | --- |
| Sliding varlen | Opt into `SelectiveGatherKVSlidingWindowVarlenInnerAttention` with contiguous or head-tail CP in one NVLink domain. |
| Full varlen | Keep `AllGatherKVVarlenInnerAttention`. |

## Numerics
Loss and grad_norm match bit-for-bit across all 20 steps, both backends, and both remat policies on job 2276942. Seed 42, deterministic mode, BF16, FA4, and CUDA Graphs. All 64 rank records and TensorBoard files agree.

## Performance
Full 52-layer Muse Glimmer, CP16 on 16 GB300s in one NVLink domain, head-tail sharding, 256K packed tokens across 17 documents capped at 16K, and 2048-token sliding windows. Full layers use all-gather in both variants. The benchmark uses this PR's public-layout code with attention-gym 38cd874 and PyTorch 087ceb5.

| Remat | Sliding backend | Step (ms) | Peak allocated (GiB) | Peak reserved (GiB) |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Full | All-gather | 2866.2 | 43.393 | 57.793 |
| Full | Copy engine | 2701.7 | 43.545 | 57.867 |
| Inner attention | All-gather | 2404.6 | 141.706 | 159.648 |
| Inner attention | Copy engine | 2227.7 | 141.857 | 159.139 |

- Copy engine reduces step time by 5.74% under full remat and 7.36% under inner remat. Peak allocated memory increases by 0.151 GiB in each pair.
- Inner remat uses save_regions=["*"] and recompute_regions=["attention.inner_attention*"]. Projection math runs once; inner attention runs twice. Bare operations outside saved regions can replay.
- One run per case on one allocation. Timing averages the slowest rank at each of 17 graph replays. Memory peaks include build, warmup, capture, and training; symmetric-memory buffers can be outside the allocator.

## Testing
- Pass each rank's `cp_query_ranges` to attention-gym `4bc108c`. All layout and plan fields match the benchmark builder across 12,496 rank-specific cases, including the full CP16 benchmark shape. Copy-engine source is unchanged. GPU checks and performance results use attention-gym `38cd874`.
- 75 TorchTitan CPU tests pass. They cover varlen attention, exchange sharing, fixed-layout rejection, remat regions, and saved K/V lifetime. Two shipped-recipe tests are excluded. Routing tests live upstream; all 39 host plan tests pass.
- The four-H100 numerical suite passes all eight combinations of contiguous/head-tail, remat off/on, and window sizes 1/4. It checks outputs, gradients, shared exchanges, changed documents, and CUDA Graph replay. The one-token window works with zero remote blocks.
- Both Muse Glimmer recipes validate. The H100 recipe was checked in isolation because the full module import fails on the torchvision issue below.
- Production validation, CP attention, and context-parallel helpers pass targeted Pyrefly with one PyTorch source path. All non-typechecking pre-commit hooks pass. Whole-worktree Pyrefly reports 195 dependency and scratch-file errors.

## Known issues
- The attention-gym release pin still lacks block exchange. Testing uses its local checkout.
- Whole-worktree typechecking reports scratch-file and dependency errors. The generic integration file has ten errors in untouched code.
- The full H100 suite cannot import torchvision locally because torchvision::nms is missing. Its existing Qwen3.5 import triggers the failure.

+# Selective-gather attention
+
+Attention-gym owns sliding-window block routing, K/V exchange, assembly,
+gradient return, and transport resources. TorchTitan maps attention inputs
+to compact K/V and sets checkpoint policy.
+
+## Supported attention
+
+Use `SelectiveGatherKVSlidingWindowVarlenInnerAttention`.
+Copy engines require one NVLink domain, which can span hosts.
+PyTorch symmetric-memory setup checks peer access.
+
+Sliding-window Varlen supports contiguous sharding and head-tail load balancing.
+Decoder applies a configured balancer only when the model has full attention.
+Each CP chunk must contain whole `gather_block_size` blocks. Attention-gym checks
+the token ranges before building the exchange.
+The default `gather_block_size=256` is a tested starting point. It rounds a
+4096-token window's 4095-token lookback to 4096 tokens, adding one unused token
+per halo. Use a smaller block when CP chunks are shorter than 256 tokens.
+Its plan is a causal-window superset of packed-document demand.
+TorchTitan passes each rank's `cp_query_ranges` to attention-gym's public
+`build_sliding_window_plan`. Returned global block IDs locate K/V slices in
+the compact buffer.
+Document boundaries may cause safe overfetch. It keeps standard
+`VarlenAttentionMetadata`; its
+document offsets can change without changing the exchange plan.
+
+Use `AllGatherKVVarlenInnerAttention` for full causal Varlen layers. A dense
+head-tail plan can need almost all remote K/V, so worst-case selective-gather
+buffers cost almost as much memory as all-gather.
+

+## K/V memory
+
+Sliding-window Varlen packs local K/V and its halos in original token
+order. Overlapping ranges share the same blocks. The last rank's adjacent
+head and tail chunks do not duplicate their shared keys. Output size is fixed
+at the largest selected block count across CP ranks, with padding at the end.
+Padding is uninitialized. Attention views exclude it.
+
+Varlen uses one view for contiguous sharding and two for head-tail.
+It does not reorder or copy the assembled K/V again. Document packing changes the
+mask or offsets, not the transport plan or buffer shape.
+
+Contiguous sharding needs at most one remote halo; head-tail needs two.
+Each halo rounds the window's
+lookback up to a transport block. With 128K local tokens, a 4096-token window,
+and 256-token blocks, the assembled buffer holds at most 136K tokens:
+
+| CP8 K/V buffer | Upper bound relative to local K/V |
+| --- | --- |
+| All-gather output | 8x |
+| Compact output, without checkpointing | 1.0625x |
+| Saved halo, with checkpointed attention | 0.0625x |
+
+These are buffer-size bounds, not measurements of model peak memory.
+They exclude other model activations and shared transport buffers.
+Full attention remains on all-gather in the sliding-window recipes.
+
+The saved activations depend on the remat policy:
+
+| Sliding-layer policy | All-gather | Selective gather |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Save inner attention | Retain gathered K/V for backward. | Retain compact K/V for backward. |
+| Full remat | Release gathered K/V and fetch it again in backward. | Retain remote halos and rebuild compact K/V locally in backward. |
+
+With full remat, all-gather also releases its gathered K/V. Selective gather
+retains halos to avoid fetching them again. Measure model peak memory for the
+chosen policy; full attention layers and CUDA Graph pools also contribute.
+
+## Benchmark
+
+52-layer Muse Glimmer, CP16 on 16 GB300s in one NVLink domain, head-tail sharding,
+256K packed tokens, and documents capped at 16K. The 39 sliding layers use a
+2048-token window; all 13 full layers use all-gather in both variants.
+Activations are BF16 with FA4 and CUDA Graphs.
+
+| Remat | Sliding backend | Step (ms) | Peak allocated (GiB) | Peak reserved (GiB) |
+| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| Full | All-gather | 2866.2 | 43.393 | 57.793 |
+| Full | Copy engine | 2701.7 | 43.545 | 57.867 |
+| Inner attention | All-gather | 2404.6 | 141.706 | 159.648 |
+| Inner attention | Copy engine | 2227.7 | 141.857 | 159.139 |
+
+Copy engine reduces step time by 5.74% under full remat and 7.36% under inner
+remat. Peak allocated memory is 0.151 GiB higher in both pairs. Loss and grad_norm
+match bit-for-bit across all 20 steps, both backends, and both remat policies.
+
+Inner remat uses `save_regions=["*"]` and
+`recompute_regions=["attention.inner_attention*"]`.
+
+Step time averages the slowest rank over 17 graph replays on one allocation.
+Allocator peaks include build, warmup, capture, and training. Symmetric-memory
+buffers can be outside the PyTorch allocator.

+the model. Do not free exchanges during capture or replay.

+        SlidingWindowVarlenInnerAttention.Config,
+    ):
+        gather_block_size: int = 256
+        """Tokens per transport block. The tested default rounds a 4096-token
+        window's 4095-token lookback to a 4096-token halo.
+        """
+
+        def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+            SlidingWindowVarlenInnerAttention.Config.__post_init__(self)
+            if self.gather_block_size <= 0:
+                raise ValueError("gather_block_size must be positive.")
+
+    def __init__(self, config: Config) -> None:
+        super().__init__(config)
+        self.sliding_window_size = config.sliding_window_size
+        self.gather_block_size = config.gather_block_size
+        self._layout: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...] | None = None
+        self._exchange: "CopyEngineBlockExchange | None" = None
+        self._exchange_key = None
+
+    def _get_exchange(
+        self,
+        k_THK: torch.Tensor,
+        v_THV: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        cp_group: dist.ProcessGroup,
+        head_tail: bool,
+    ) -> "CopyEngineBlockExchange":
+        key = (
+            cp_group,
+            head_tail,
+            k_THK.shape,
+            v_THV.shape,
+            k_THK.dtype,
+            v_THV.dtype,
+            k_THK.device,
+            v_THV.device,
+        )
+        exchange = self._exchange
+        if exchange is None:
+            if k_THK.is_cuda and torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+                raise ValueError("Warm up selective gather before CUDA Graph capture.")
+            from attn_gym.distributed.selective_gather import build_sliding_window_plan
+
+            cp_size = cp_group.size()
+            global_tokens = k_THK.shape[0] * cp_size
+            local_ranges = [
+                cp_query_ranges(global_tokens, cp_size, rank, head_tail=head_tail)
+                for rank in range(cp_size)
+            ]
+            plan, layout = build_sliding_window_plan(
+                local_ranges,
+                rank=cp_group.rank(),
+                block_tokens=self.gather_block_size,
+                sliding_window_size=self.sliding_window_size,
+            )
+            exchange = get_copy_engine_block_exchange(
+                cp_group,
+                plan,
+                k_token_shape=k_THK.shape[1:],
+                v_token_shape=v_THV.shape[1:],
+                dtype=k_THK.dtype,
+                device=k_THK.device,
+            )
+            self._exchange = exchange
+            self._layout = layout
+            self._exchange_key = key
+        elif self._exchange_key != key:
+            raise ValueError("Selective gather requires fixed K/V layout and CP group.")
+        return exchange
+
+    def _exchange_kv(
+        self,
+        exchange: "CopyEngineBlockExchange",
+        k_THK: torch.Tensor,
+        v_THV: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        # Unconfigured attention uses fused exchange without remat.
+        recompute = bool(self._remat_module_fqn) and self.remat_should_recompute(
+            "assemble_kv"
+        )
+        with spmd.no_typecheck():
+            if recompute:
+                # Keep the halo; backward repeats only local assembly.
+                remote_k_RHK, remote_v_RHV = remat.region(
+                    exchange.exchange,
+                    self.remat_region_name("remote_kv"),
+                    recompute=False,
+                )(k_THK, v_THV)
+                compact_k_THK, compact_v_THV = remat.region(
+                    exchange.assemble,
+                    self.remat_region_name("assemble_kv"),
+                    recompute=True,
+                )(k_THK, v_THV, remote_k_RHK, remote_v_RHV)
+            else:
+                compact_k_THK, compact_v_THV = remat.region(
+                    exchange.exchange_and_assemble,
+                    self.remat_region_name("assemble_kv"),
+                    recompute=False,
+                )(k_THK, v_THV)
+        spmd.assert_local_type_like(compact_k_THK, k_THK)
+        spmd.assert_local_type_like(compact_v_THV, v_THV)
+        return compact_k_THK, compact_v_THV
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def prepare_cp_metadata(
+        attention_metadata: VarlenAttentionMetadata,
+        *,
+        permutation: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> _SelectiveGatherVarlenMetadata:
+        _validate_varlen_cp_metadata(attention_metadata, permutation=permutation)
+        if attention_metadata.window_size[0] < 0:
+            raise ValueError("Selective gather requires a sliding window.")
+        return _SelectiveGatherVarlenMetadata(
+            cu_seq_q=attention_metadata.cu_seq_q,
+            cu_seq_k=attention_metadata.cu_seq_k,
+            max_q=attention_metadata.max_q,
+            max_k=attention_metadata.max_k,
+            window_size=attention_metadata.window_size,
+            head_tail=permutation is not None,
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        q_THK: torch.Tensor,
+        k_THK: torch.Tensor,
+        v_THV: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        attention_metadata: _SelectiveGatherVarlenMetadata,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not isinstance(attention_metadata, _SelectiveGatherVarlenMetadata):
+            raise ValueError("Selective gather requires prepared CP metadata.")
+        cp_group = spmd_mesh_group(MeshAxisName.CP)
+        if cp_group is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("Selective gather requires a multi-rank CP axis.")
+        exchange = self._get_exchange(
+            k_THK, v_THV, cp_group=cp_group, head_tail=attention_metadata.head_tail
+        )
+        compact_k_THK, compact_v_THV = self._exchange_kv(exchange, k_THK, v_THV)
+        assert self._layout is not None
+        rank = cp_group.rank()
+        global_blocks = self._layout[rank]
+        remat.recompute_needs_tensor(compact_k_THK, compact_v_THV)
+
+        def select_kv(kv_start: int, end: int) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+            # Each chunk's K/V interval is contiguous in the compact buffer.
+            offset = (
+                bisect_left(global_blocks, kv_start // self.gather_block_size)
+                * self.gather_block_size
+                + kv_start % self.gather_block_size
+            )
+            stop = offset + end - kv_start
+            return compact_k_THK[offset:stop], compact_v_THV[offset:stop]
+
+        return _run_varlen_cp_attention(
+            self,
+            q_THK,
+            attention_metadata=attention_metadata,
+            query_runs=cp_query_ranges(
+                k_THK.shape[0] * cp_group.size(),
+                cp_group.size(),
+                rank,
+                head_tail=attention_metadata.head_tail,
+            ),
+            select_kv=select_kv,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
